title: mTVR: Multilingual Moment Retrieval in Videos

problems.name: Scalability and Corpus-Level Retrieval
problems.evidence_sentence: Recent work (Escorcia et al., 2019; Lei et al., 2020) introduced the Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR) task: given a natural language query, a system needs to retrieve a short moment from a large video corpus.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: The dataset is collected by extending the popular TVR dataset (in English) with paired Chinese queries and subtitles.

problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Recent work (Escorcia et al., 2019; Lei et al., 2020) introduced the Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR) task: given a natural language query, a system needs to retrieve a short moment from a large video corpus.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: Data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/jayleicn/mTVRetrieval # Abstract We introduce mTVR, a large-scale multilingual video moment retrieval dataset, containing 218K English and Chinese queries from 21.8K TV show video clips.

methods.name: Pretraining, Pseudo-Labeling, and Data Generation
methods.evidence_sentence: The dataset is collected by extending the popular TVR dataset (in English) with paired Chinese queries and subtitles.
